clue.text: Exercise taken by domestic animals back in the plain

indicators.note: back tells us to read the word for the pets from right to left

parts.note: domestic animals kept at home are pets
PE is physical education, school exercise

explanation.surface: Animals out on the flat land are being exercised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns the pets word round; 'plain' is the flat grassland, not the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A steppe is a vast treeless grassy flatland, such as those of Central Asia.

clue.text: Force engaged in the transmission of motion?

definitions.text: engaged in the transmission of motion?

explanation.surface: A force at work in a machine's drive.
explanation.definitionFit: A law with real bite has power to enforce it, and the cogs on gear wheels mesh to pass on motion.

clue.text: Coercive group of criminals holding up the fourth estate

indicators.note: in a down answer, one piece holding up another sits above it, so the fourth estate's word comes first

parts.note: the fourth estate is a traditional name for journalists, the press
a band of criminals is a gang

explanation.surface: Organised crooks keeping the newspapers propped up.
explanation.walkthrough: PRESS GANGs once seized men by force for naval service.
explanation.definitionFit: A press gang forcibly enlisted men into the navy, a band that compelled service.

clue.text: They go off Latin

parts.note: read as a stage direction: the Latin word a script uses when several actors leave the stage

explanation.surface: Some people leave in Latin fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Latin stage direction meaning that several characters depart.

clue.text: Traitor in Paris who is gaining support

parts.note: the French word for who is qui
a sling supports an injured arm

explanation.surface: A turncoat in the French capital is gaining backing.
explanation.walkthrough: Vidkun Quisling collaborated with the Nazis in occupied Norway; his name became a byword.
explanation.definitionFit: A quisling is a collaborator who betrays his country to an occupying enemy.

clue.text: Where judges terminated terrible noises made in digs?

definitions.text: Where judges terminated terrible noises made in digs?

indicators.note: made in says the rebuilt letters are placed inside the word for lodgings

parts.note: digs is British slang for lodgings, quarters

indicators.note: terminated means take only the end letter of the word judges
terrible signals the letters of noises are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A court where judges put an end to awful racket in lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: Quarter sessions were English county courts held four times a year and abolished in 1971, which is why the judges were 'terminated'.
explanation.definitionFit: Quarter sessions were periodic local criminal courts where judges and magistrates sat.

clue.text: It's not just the position of a British actor

definitions.text: the position of a British actor

explanation.surface: Being a British actor is more than a matter of position.
explanation.walkthrough: Equity is the British actors' trade union, so a member is 'in Equity'.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that is not just is an unfairness, and a working British actor holds union membership.

clue.text: Bound by deadline

explanation.surface: Restricted by a closing date.
explanation.definitionFit: A bound is a boundary or ceiling, and a deadline is a time ceiling.

clue.text: Contrived to run clan in a dark period

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plot to get a family running in a gloomy era.
explanation.definitionFit: Nocturnal describes what happens by night, the dark hours.

clue.text: Fall off base

explanation.surface: Tumble from the foundation.
explanation.definitionFit: To fall off is to decline or deteriorate, and base means morally low or depraved.

clue.text: Note about current office staff

indicators.note: about means one piece goes round the other here

parts.note: me (mi) is a note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: A memo about the present state of the office workers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'office staff' looks like employees; it is the ceremonial rod of office.
explanation.definitionFit: A mace is a ceremonial rod carried as a symbol of authority.

clue.text: Horse box used by colonel, say?

parts.note: colonel is said like kernel, and a kernel is a nut

explanation.surface: A horsebox used by an army officer.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed clue joins 'Horse-box'; split it so 'Horse' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A chestnut is a reddish-brown horse.

clue.text: Game played in a French square by English? Not so

indicators.note: the game is played inside, so its letters sit within the others

explanation.surface: A sport in a French town square involving English visitors? False.
explanation.definitionFit: Untrue means false, not the case.

clue.text: It concealed a horse in the old story

indicators.note: concealed means the first pieces hide the horse inside them

parts.note: gee, a horse in nursery talk, gives G

explanation.surface: The Trojan horse hid inside it in the ancient tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'It' is a crossword convention for sex appeal, SA; 'concealed' puts G (gee-gee) between SA and A.
explanation.definitionFit: A saga is an old Norse or Icelandic tale of heroes.

clue.text: Express regret for record found in a carriage

indicators.note: found in means the record sits inside the word for bearing

explanation.surface: Say sorry for a disc discovered in a coach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carriage' looks like a vehicle; it is deportment, POISE.
explanation.definitionFit: To apologise is to say sorry.

clue.text: Shy about dressing in an archaic fashion

parts.note: tire is an archaic verb for attire, to dress

explanation.surface: Bashful about wearing old-fashioned clothes.
explanation.definitionFit: A retiring person is reserved and modest.

clue.text: Refusal to have a North American leading in preliminary survey

indicators.note: the survey is to have the other letters within it

parts.note: a recce is a reconnaissance, an initial survey

indicators.note: leading puts the American abbreviation in front

explanation.surface: Declining to have a Canadian or American at the head of an early study.
explanation.walkthrough: Recusance was refusal to attend Church of England services.
explanation.definitionFit: Recusance means refusal to submit, especially to an established church.

clue.text: Lavengro hesitatingly rejecting Polonius's* advice?

parts.note: Lavengro is a novel by George Borrow, so it stands for its author

explanation.surface: A novel's author, hesitantly ignoring a Shakespearean old man's counsel.
explanation.walkthrough: In Hamlet, Polonius advises 'Neither a borrower nor a lender be'.
explanation.definitionFit: One who takes a loan ignores the counsel to avoid loans.

clue.text: Deceive sweetheart about origin of garden plant

indicators.note: about means the two words go round the other letter

parts.note: love is a term for a sweetheart

indicators.note: origin of means the first letter of garden

explanation.surface: Fool your lover over where a garden began.
explanation.definitionFit: The foxglove is a tall flowering plant, the source of digitalis.

clue.text: Church officer in Cornwall, perhaps

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A churchwarden in a West Country county.
explanation.walkthrough: Cornwall, the westernmost county of England, has Celtic roots; the definition means one found there.
explanation.definitionFit: Cornish people are a Celtic nation, so a native there is an example of such.

clue.text: A job providing accommodation for soldiers

explanation.surface: Employment that gives troops lodging.
explanation.definitionFit: A billet is informally a post or position, and also quarters assigned to troops.

clue.text: Ben Battle abandoned one to form an attachment

indicators.note: abandoned means the letter for one is dropped

parts.note: Ben Battle was a soldier bold, in Thomas Hood's comic poem Faithless Nelly Gray

explanation.surface: Ben Battle left one person to forge a bond.
explanation.walkthrough: Hood's poem opens 'Ben Battle was a soldier bold'.
explanation.definitionFit: To solder is to join metal pieces with molten alloy.

clue.text: Flag raised by indigent Democrat

indicators.note: raised in a down answer means read the pieces upwards, backwards

explanation.surface: A banner held aloft by a needy politician.
explanation.definitionFit: To flag is to tire and sag.

clue.text: Carrier loses balance at first, being down at heel

indicators.note: at first puts the losing-balance word ahead of the carrier

explanation.surface: A porter stumbles first, looking shabby.
explanation.definitionFit: Slipshod means careless or shabby.

clue.text: In which we hope Radames's soul will be saved

definitions.text: In which we hope Radames's soul will be saved

indicators.note: saved means the letters are kept within the words

explanation.surface: A drama where we wish the hero's soul to be redeemed.
explanation.walkthrough: Radames is the hero of Verdi's Aida; the answer sits within 'hope Radames's'.
explanation.definitionFit: Radames is the hero of a Verdi opera, so the work is where his fate plays out.

clue.text: Engineer oils missile launcher

indicators.note: to engineer is to arrange, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mechanic oils a rocket launcher.
explanation.definitionFit: A silo is an underground launch shaft for missiles.

clue.text: Hardy type of countryman, Giles Winterbome

definitions.text: Hardy type of countryman, Giles Winterbome

parts.words: Hardy type of countryman, Giles Winterbome
parts.note: Hardy is Thomas Hardy, and Giles Winterborne (printed Winterbome) is a forest dweller in one of his novels

explanation.surface: A tough rural man named Giles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hardy' looks like tough; it is the novelist Thomas Hardy.
explanation.definitionFit: Giles Winterborne is a forest-dwelling character in Hardy's novel The Woodlanders.

clue.text: Star he observed when going by ship round Pacific state

indicators.note: round means the ship's letters go around the state

parts.note: Peru is a country on the Pacific

explanation.surface: A star he saw sailing around a South American country.
explanation.definitionFit: Hesperus is the evening star, Venus.

clue.text: Snatch back the leading Boeotian citizen

indicators.note: leading puts the word the first
back means read the word for snatch backwards

explanation.surface: Grab back the foremost Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns NAB into BAN. Thebes was the chief city of Boeotia in Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Thebes was in Boeotia, so its inhabitant was a Boeotian.
